Subj: FISCAL YEAR 2027 SELECTED RESERV E HEALTH PROFESSIONS OFFICERS IN
CRITICAL WARTIME SPECIALTIES RECRUITING AND RETENTION
INCENTIVES
Ref: (a) Assistant Secretar y of War for Health Affairs Memorandum of 15 July 2026
(b) RESPERS M-1001.5
(c) 37 U.S.C
(d) DoD Instruction 6000.13 of 3 May 2016
(e) DoD Instruction 1304.34 of 11 July 2016
Encl: (1) Fiscal Year 2027 SELRES Critical Wartime Specialties Incentive Pay Chart
1. Purpose. The Department of the Navy (DoN ) authorizes monetary incentives for health
professions officers (HPOs) with critical wartime skills to maintain readiness of the Reserve
Component (RC). The HPO recruiting and retention program targets specific critical wartime
subspecialties as designated in reference (a). These incentives are designed to encourage
accession, affiliation, and retention of health professionals with critical skills for specified
periods of obligated service to meet Selected Reserve (SELRES) personnel requirements in the
most cost-effective manner to support force management objectives. This notice is effective as
of 1 October 2026.
2. Introduction. The DoN authorizes a special bonus for HPOs. All HPO specialties identified
by the Assistant Secretary of Defense for Health Affairs in the HPO Special and Incentive Pay
Plan Memorandum are referred to as Critical Skill Shortages. The Navy Reserve will use the
bonus program in the most cost-effective manner to support force management objectives.
4. Scope and Applicability. This notice applies to all Navy SELRES HPOs.
5. Policy. All program polici es contained in reference (b), articles 1100-010 and 1100-040,
remain in effect unless amended or amplified in this notice. These articles provide guidance and
responsibilities for SELRES personnel, Navy Reserve Activities (NRA), and echelon 4
commands and amplifying information on HPO incentives such ass service obligation, eligibility
and application procedures.
6. Amplifying Guidance. If reference (a) is superseded while this letter is in effect,
subspecialties that do not appear on the most recent version of reference (a) will no longer be
eligible for the incentives offered and any outstanding incentive agreements will be cancelled.

7. Terms. Incentives ou tlined within this policy are governed by references (a) through (e).
8. Timeline. For award levels decreased by encl osure (1), existing quotas and pre-certification
letters may be grandfathered under the previous policy up to 30 days after the effective date of
this notice listed in paragraph 1. Incentives will be processed per the policy in effect at the time
of accession, affiliation, or retention.
a. Bonus agreements must be executed based on the applicable effective date. The effective
date for all incentives described in the policy are listed in subparagraphs 8a(1) through 8a(3).
(1) Accession or Affiliation. Is the effective date indicated on the NAVPERS 1200/1
Ready Reserve Transfer Request Service Agreement.
(2) Special Pay in Lieu of Accession or Affiliation. Is the effective date indicated on the
NAVPERS 1200/1.
(3) Retention or Renegotiation. The effective date is the date of endorsement by the
member, as indicated in the written agreement.
b. NRAs are responsible for en suring incentive agreements are executed or declined by the
SELRES member within 90 days after the member’s first inactive duty training period. Per
reference (b), members declining to accept the bonus will sign a declination NAVPERS
1070/613 Administrative Remarks. The NRA will process all signed agreements and
declinations within 5 days of receipt.
9. Bonus Payout Structure. Bonuses will be paid according to the pay chart in enclosure (1).
All payments are taxable.
a. The critical wartime specialty bonus is paid annually.
b. Eligibility for anniversar y payments is contingent upon the member maintaining
satisfactory participation in the designator or specialty for each year of the bonus contract.
c. Members who affiliate to fu lfill a contractual SELRES service obligation are ineligible
for bonuses until the contracted SELRES service obligation is complete.
d. Per reference (b), the request to renegotiate must occur within 60 days prior to the due
date of the second or third installment. The effective date of the new agreement will coincide
with the due date of the second or third installment. Renegotiations will be paid out based on the
new due date(s).
e. SELRES HPO critical wartime specialty acc ession bonuses are paid as annual rates for
DCO appointments in the Navy Reserve after successful completion of Officer Development
School.

f. Reserve HPOs 58 or older who believe they are eligible for a bonus under current policy
must contact their respective NRA bonus coordinator to initiate the review process. Upon
notification from the eligible officer, the NRA bonus coordinator will coordinate with their
immediate superior in command (ISIC) and Commander, Navy Reserve Forces Command NI I
to ensure the member can meet all bonus eligibility requirements before the agreement is
finalized. Written agreement obligations will not exceed the Reserve mandatory separation age
of 62 unless an official continuation waiver is granted. If a Reserve HPO is granted an official
continuation waiver to defer separation, the bonus written agreement obligation duration must be
strictly limited to the validity period of that approved continuation waiver and written agreement
limitations. Under no circumstances will any Reserve bonus written agreement extend beyond
the absolute statutory limit of 68 years of age, consistent with the maximum Reserve retention
authorities for HPOs as detailed in 10 U.S.C. § 14703 unless approved by the Secretary of the
Navy.
I 0. Final Adjudication Authori tv. The Office of the Chief of Naval Operations (OPNA V) N095 l
is the final adjudication authority for recruiting and retention incentives for Reserve Component
HPOs. Eligibility, termination, and repayment inquiries will be routed to OPNAV N0951 via
Commander, Navy Reserve Force NI. This does not include remission or waiver of
indebtedness cases. Any request for remission or waiver of indebtedness will be adjudicated by
proper authority per applicable statute, Department of War regulations, and DoN Guidance.
11. Points of Contact. Members should contact the bonus program coordinator at their respective
NRA. NRAs will direct any execution or policy concerns to their ISIC manpower and personnel
support representative.
12. Records Management. Records created as a result of this instruction, regardless of the media
and format must be managed per Secretary of the Navy Manual 5210.1 of September 2019.
13. Cancellation Contin gency. This notice is in effect until it is superseded by another notice or
policy change.

Notes
1. HPOs listed on the critical wartime speciality list can receive a RC accession,
affiliation, or retention bonus. Eligibility requirements are outlined in DoDI 6000.13,
specifically:
a. (AB Column) RC Accession Bonus Elig ibility: A member must have been
discharged at least 24 months before execution of the written agreement and no longer hold
an appointment.
b. (AB Column) RC Affiliation Bonus E ligibility: A member must have been
discharged from the Uniformed Service as evidenced by providing an original or certified
DD Form 214 Certificate of Release or Discharge from Active Duty and be qualified in the
specialty in which they agree to serve.

c. (RB Column) RC retention bonuses may be taken in lieu of an AB referenced in
notes section 1b. and it may be given multiple times in an officer’s career.
d. The RC Health Professions Loan Repa yment Program may only be taken if there
is no contract in place for an accession or AB or special pay.
2. Accession bonuses are a 3-year service obligation.
3. RC special pay in lieu of accession or affiliation is an accession/affiliation (AB
Column) bonus incentive with a 4-year service obligation.
4. Members may enter a retent ion bonus written agreement to remain in an active status
in the RC as an HPO for 2, 3, or 4 years.
